Bill.BriefDescription: Providing an exemption from the passenger vehicle weight fee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an exemption from the passenger vehicle weightfee; adding a new section to chapter 46.17 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The vehicle weight fee imposed under RCW 46.17.010 does notapply to a vehicle with an empty scale weight of less than ten thousandpounds if the vehicle is: (a) Registered to a person with adisability; and (b) modified to include a wheelchair ramp, wheelchairlift, or other equipment needed or used solely for disability access toa vehicle. (2) Application for exemption under this section must be made tothe department in a form and manner required by the department. Theexemption shall apply to registration periods occurring on or after thedate of application for exemption.
